
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/sollong/p/19584026" title="发布于 2026-02-06 13:37">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Redmi AX6 TTL 救砖记录</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        记一次红米 AX6 普砖TTL救砖过程。本文通过 TTL 串口利用 TFTP 在UBoot命令行 修复MIBIB分区表，重新刷入 OpenWrt 固件。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p><em>仅做一次记录,可能会有不理解和错误的地方</em></p>
<h1 id="背景">背景</h1>
<p>刷过不死Uboot + ImmortalWrt, 想刷回原厂固件,试图刷原厂分区因操作分区表不当成普砖.</p>
<blockquote>
<p>砖度判断:<a href="https://www.right.com.cn/forum/thread-5181728-1-1.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">引用恩山</a><br>
一台刷砖的AX6，先判定是普通砖还是深度砖，普通砖TTL可救，深度砖编程器才能救：<br>
1、普通砖：上电SYS黄灯常亮，过会儿双黄灯闪一下又开始SYS黄灯常亮，然后重复。<br>
——这种UBOOT未损坏（一般是sysupgrade、ubiformat指令或web里写入固件失败导致）。<br>
2、深度砖：接上电源，双黄灯闪一下，过几秒双黄灯又闪一下，然后重复。<br>
——这种UBOOT已损坏（一般刷入新分区表文件后漏拔电重启步骤），请走售后或拆ROM芯片上编程器。</p>
</blockquote>
<p>试图小米路由器修复工具救砖,但是不识别,无反应<br>
在后续的串口信息发现分区表变成这样:</p>
<pre><code>IPQ807x#   mtdparts
device nand0 &lt;nand0&gt;, # parts = 1
 #: name                size            offset          mask_flags
 0: fs                  0x023c0000      0x02dc0000      0

active partition: nand0,0 - (fs) 0x023c0000 @ 0x02dc0000

defaults:
mtdids  : none
mtdparts: none
</code></pre>
<p>经判断这次是普通砖,使用TTL救砖.</p>
<h1 id="大致思路">大致思路</h1>
<p>重刷分区表和openwrt固件再用小米路由器修复工具刷回原厂固件</p>
<h1 id="准备工作">准备工作</h1>
<ol>
<li>USB转TTL工具 + 杜邦线 这里使用CH340G (记得装驱动)</li>
</ol>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3309763/202601/3309763-20260131231407423-1048980357.jpg" alt="test2" width="300" height="200" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3309763/202601/3309763-20260131231413635-1323732633.jpg" alt="test" width="300" height="200" loading="lazy"></p>
<ol start="2">
<li><a href="https://www.chiark.greenend.org.uk/~sgtatham/putty/latest.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Putty</a> 进行串口通信</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/PJO2/tftpd64/releases" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">tftpd64</a> 用于搭建本地 TFTP 服务器，传输文件</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/ZqinKing/wrt_release/releases" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">ImmortalWrt</a>原厂分区固件 这里使用immortalwrt-qualcommax-ipq807x-redmi_ax6-stock-squashfs-factory.ubi</li>
<li>原厂分区表文件mibib.bin</li>
<li><a href="https://bigota.miwifi.com/xiaoqiang/tools/MIWIFIRepairTool.x86.zip" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">小米路由器修复工具</a></li>
</ol>
<p>将分区表文件mibib.bin和固件immortalwrt-qualcommax-ipq807x-redmi_ax6-stock-squashfs-factory.ubi放入tftpd64目录<br>
immortalwrt-qualcommax-ipq807x-redmi_ax6-stock-squashfs-factory.ubi在本文中被改名成test.bin</p>
<h1 id="章节1-拆机找ttl触点-连线进行putty串口通信">章节1 拆机找TTL触点 连线进行Putty串口通信</h1>
<p>大概在这个位置:<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3309763/202601/3309763-20260131231947950-1180083227.png" alt="202921e8t5jtztgt4ztguc" width="300" height="200" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>可以焊个4pin针方便连接</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3309763/202601/3309763-20260131233641930-1376623072.png" alt="image" width="300" height="200" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>*CH340G跳线帽需短接在 3.3V 模式 *</p>
<p>PC插上CH340G 在设备管理器查看它的端口号<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3309763/202602/3309763-20260206134347304-1019943611.png" alt="设备管理器" width="300" height="200" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>在putty设置:<br>
Connection type: Serial<br>
Serial line: COM5 &lt;--用实际CH340G的端口号<br>
Speed (Baud rate): 115200</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3309763/202601/3309763-20260131233134423-1601931815.png" alt="image" width="300" height="200" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>然后按照以下逻辑相联</p>
<pre><code>CH340G GND       &lt;--&gt; 路由器 GND
CH340G TX (发送) &lt;--&gt; 路由器 RX (接收)
CH340G RX (接收) &lt;--&gt; 路由器 TX (发送)
VCC不连
</code></pre>
<p><em>路由器通电之后再接TTL,不然路由器无法启动</em></p>
<p>正常情况应该是路由器开始闪黄灯,putty开始输出:</p>
<pre><code>...
U-Boot 2016.01 (Jul 08 2021 - 07:16:48 +0000), Build: jenkins-common_router_openwrt_ota_publish-1455

DRAM:  smem ram ptable found: ver: 1 len: 4
512 MiB
NAND:  ONFI device found
ID = 158061c8
Vendor = c8
Device = 61
SF: Unsupported flash IDs: manuf ff, jedec ffff, ext_jedec ffff
ipq_spi: SPI Flash not found (bus/cs/speed/mode) = (0/0/48000000/0)
128 MiB
MMC:   sdhci: Node Not found, skipping initialization

PCI1 is not defined in the device tree
In:    serial@78B3000
Out:   serial@78B3000
Err:   serial@78B3000
machid: 8010010
MMC Device 0 not found
eth5 MAC Address from ART is not valid
write phy_id=1, reg(0x8074):0x0670
write phy_id=2, reg(0x8074):0x0670
write phy_id=3, reg(0x8074):0x0670
write phy_id=4, reg(0x8074):0x0670
bootwait is on, bootdelay=2
Hit any key to stop autoboot:  0
 trigger button release!
boot from rootfs 0
  miwifi: check crash in rmem !
ubi0: attaching mtd1
ubi0: scanning is finished
UBI init error 22
Erasing NAND...
Erasing at 0x6e0000 -- 100% complete.
Writing to NAND... OK
resetting ...

</code></pre>
<p>我们需要在</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">Hit any key to stop autoboot:  0
</code></pre>
<p>倒计时结束前按任意键如 Ctrl+C 或者 Enter<br>
呼出UBOOT命令行 <em>IPQ807x#</em><br>
如果倒计时过短或者压根没有bootwait,可以试着按住reset再通电再接TTL再试图中断呼出UBOOT命令行</p>
<pre><code>Hit any key to stop autoboot:  0
 detect button press, continue check 5 secs
 detect button pressed 5 secs !
 confirm to launch xq_upgrade ! &lt;--检测到reset,进入原厂救援模式
</code></pre>
<h1 id="章节2-修复分区表">章节2 修复分区表</h1>
<p>查询当前分区表,发现已经变成以下这种情况了</p>
<pre><code>IPQ807x#   mtdparts
device nand0 &lt;nand0&gt;, # parts = 1
 #: name                size            offset          mask_flags
 0: fs                  0x023c0000      0x02dc0000      0
active partition: nand0,0 - (fs) 0x023c0000 @ 0x02dc0000
defaults:
mtdids  : none
mtdparts: none
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>Gemini:<br>
parts = 1：你的闪存里现在只认出了1个分区。<br>
Name: fs：这就是为什么启动会失败，它找不到 rootfs，只找到了个叫 fs 的残余分区。<br>
Offset: 0x02dc0000：好消息是，这个地址正好是 AX6 原厂固件 rootfs (系统分区) 的起始物理地址。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="重刷分区表-mibibbin-到物理地址-0x40000">重刷分区表 mibib.bin 到物理地址 0x40000</h2>
<h3 id="电脑网卡设置">电脑网卡设置</h3>
<p>先设置连接路由器的网卡:<br>
IP: 192.168.31.100<br>
掩码: 255.255.255.0<br>
网关: 192.168.31.1</p>
<h3 id="配置tftpd">配置Tftpd</h3>
<p>打开Tftpd64-设置-DHCP<br>
IP pool start address: 192.168.31.2<br>
Size of pool: 5<br>
Router (Opt 3): 填入 192.168.31.1<br>
Mask: 255.255.255.0<br>
WINS/DNS: 填 0.0.0.0 或者留空即可。</p>
<p>Tftpd64主界面<br>
Server interfaces 选择相应网卡</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3309763/202602/3309763-20260205204518215-1615573348.png" alt="image" width="300" height="400" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="重刷分区表">重刷分区表</h3>
<h4 id="将分区表文件mibibbin-下载到内存">将分区表文件mibib.bin 下载到内存</h4>
<p>在UBOOT命令行输入:<br>
设置TFTP服务器</p>
<pre><code>IPQ807x# setenv serverip 192.168.31.100
IPQ807x# setenv ipaddr 192.168.31.2
</code></pre>
<pre><code>
IPQ807x# tftpboot 0x44000000 mibib.bin 
</code></pre>
<h4 id="擦除-mibib-所在的区块">擦除 MIBIB 所在的区块</h4>
<pre><code>IPQ807x# nand erase 0x40000 0x40000
</code></pre>
<h4 id="写入-mibib">写入 MIBIB</h4>
<pre><code>IPQ807x# nand write 0x44000000 0x40000 0x40000
</code></pre>
<h2 id="设置启动标志并重置环境变量">设置启动标志并重置环境变量</h2>
<pre><code>IPQ807x# env default -a
IPQ807x# saveenv
IPQ807x# reset
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>env default -a<br>
gemini:<br>
这步操作相当于给 U-Boot 进行了一次“格式化大脑”。它忘掉了所有错误的旧设置，重启后重新从闪存里读取了你之前刷进去的那个正确的 mibib.bin。</p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="章节3-刷入openwrt底包">章节3 刷入Openwrt底包</h1>
<h2 id="通过tftp下载固件到路由器内存">通过tftp下载固件到路由器内存</h2>
<p>重新设置TFTP服务器</p>
<pre><code>IPQ807x# setenv serverip 192.168.31.100
IPQ807x# setenv ipaddr 192.168.31.2
</code></pre>
<p>下载固件到内存</p>
<pre><code>IPQ807x# tftpboot 0x44000000 test.bin
</code></pre>
<h2 id="擦除rootfs分区">擦除rootfs分区</h2>
<pre><code>IPQ807x# nand erase 0x2dc0000 0x23c0000
</code></pre>
<h2 id="将固件写入分区">将固件写入分区</h2>
<pre><code>IPQ807x# nand write 0x44000000 0x2dc0000 0x1c50000
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>使用nand write 0x44000000 0x2dc0000 $filesize<br>
会报错<br>
IPQ807x# nand write 0x44000000 0x2dc0000 $filesize<br>
NAND write: device 0 offset 0x2dc0000, size 0x1c403bc<br>
NAND write to offset 2dc0000 failed -22<br>
Gemini:<br>
NAND write ... failed -22 是完全预料之中的，也是个“好”错误。<br>
原因：-22 代表 "Invalid Argument" (参数无效)。<br>
详解：NAND Flash 的写入必须严格按照页大小 (Page Size) 对齐（通常是 2048 字节或 4096 字节）。你的固件大小是 0x1c403bc，末尾的 3bc 说明它没有对齐，所以 U-Boot 拒绝写入。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="保存环境变量">保存环境变量</h2>
<pre><code>IPQ807x# saveenv
IPQ807x# reset
</code></pre>
<p>出现resetting...后重新接TTL线,不出意外的话加载一会后串口应该会显示:</p>
<pre><code>## Loading kernel from FIT Image at 44000000 ...
   Using 'config@ac04' configuration
   Trying 'kernel-1' kernel subimage
     Description:  ARM64 OpenWrt Linux-6.12.60
     Type:         Kernel Image
     Compression:  gzip compressed
     Data Start:   0x440000e8
     Data Size:    5599108 Bytes = 5.3 MiB

</code></pre>
<h1 id="章节3-小米路由器修复工具刷回原厂官方固件">章节3 小米路由器修复工具刷回原厂官方固件</h1>
<p>进入immortalwrt bash 查看当前分区信息,可以看见已经还原分区表了<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3309763/202602/3309763-20260205221018952-1473979721.png" alt="恢复成功mtd" width="400" height="300" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>接下来就可以捅reset然后用小米路由器修复工具刷原厂官方固件了<br>
这部分就省略了</p>
<h1 id="结尾">结尾</h1>
<p>感谢网上各路大神的教程和Gemini的帮助,但是貌似bdata丢了,没SN码和MAC地址了<br>
累了,先不折腾了,下次一定</p>
